---
title: "Precomputed results"
---

Welcome to the ELIXIR-UK RDM Club notebook showcase. This site presents four
Quarto notebooks built around **precomputed results**. The notebooks are
rendered as part of the site build; readers do not need to run the analyses.

## Notebooks

1. [Overview](notebooks/01-overview.qmd) — describe the dataset and provenance.
2. [Exploration](notebooks/02-exploration.qmd) — show exploratory summaries.
3. [Analysis](notebooks/03-analysis.qmd) — present the main analysis.
4. [Results](notebooks/04-results.qmd) — interpret and share the findings.

Replace the starter text and example values in each notebook with your project
content. Store reusable, precomputed inputs under `data/` and figures under
`figures/`.
